definition: Adobe Experience Platform Launch is a tag-management system for deploying and governing scripts and data collection rules across digital properties.
entry_text: Adobe Experience Platform Launch is a tag-management system for deploying and governing scripts and data collection rules across digital properties.
example: A measurement team updates an approved analytics rule without editing each page individually.
label: Adobe Experience Platform Launch

sources.note: Adobe identifies Launch with Tags in Adobe Experience Platform, used to deploy scripts for data collection and personalization. Preserve Launch as a legacy name rather than present it as the current feature name. This refers to web data-collection tags, not administrative metadata tags.
